relation_to_submission: Independent exploratory cross-continental mechanism test; no RC11 story change is authorized.

sample.records: All weak-label rows with MONITORING_SITE == INCT20955 and a parseable AUDIO_FILE_ID date/time.
sample.annotation: 42 species Calling Index columns coded 0 absence, 1 low, 2 moderate, 3 high.
sample.note: Weak-label files were stratified by breeding-season months and nighttime calling periods in the source study; month/year/hour adjustment is therefore required.

exposure.source: Earthmover public Icechunk ERA5, single/temporal tp
exposure.definition: Number of complete coordinate-local calendar days immediately preceding the recording date until first day with >=1 mm precipitation, capped at 30; analyze zscore(log1p(dry_days)).
exposure.coordinate_grid: nearest ERA5 0.25-degree cell to the fixed site coordinate

exact_decomposition.total_ci: sum of the 42 species Calling Index values in a 1-minute recording
exact_decomposition.active_richness: count of species with Calling Index > 0
exact_decomposition.identity: total_ci = active_richness + excess_intensity for every recording

model.formula: response ~ dry_z + C(month) + year_z + sin_hour + cos_hour
model.estimator: OLS with covariance clustered by local recording date

prefixed_replication_rule.recent_rain_total_activity: total_ci dry_z beta < 0 and complete 95% CI < 0
prefixed_replication_rule.recruitment_component: active_richness dry_z beta < 0 and complete 95% CI < 0
prefixed_replication_rule.threshold_dominant: recent_rain_total_activity AND recruitment_component AND active_richness beta / total_ci beta > 0.5 AND abs(active_richness beta) > abs(excess_intensity beta)
prefixed_replication_rule.interpretation: If passed, the North American conclusion that rainfall-associated acoustic change is dominated by crossing from inactive to active participation rather than only greater intensity among already-active taxa gains an independent Neotropical analogue. This is not a replication of NAAMP spatial boundary geometry.

sensitivities.no_zero_anuran_recordings: Repeat on recordings with total_ci > 0 to show whether recent-rain richness deepening persists among already-active recordings; no threshold-dominance gate because zeros are conditioned away.
sensitivities.one_recording_per_date_hour_bin: Deterministically retain first AUDIO_FILE_ID within local date x integer hour to reduce duplicate temporal weighting; directional diagnostic only.

prohibited: No spatial-boundary universality claim from one recorder at this site.
No claim that annotation sampling represents continuous effort.
No RC11 manuscript modification based on this exploration.

coordinate_evidence.rationale: Do not invent a point coordinate; propagate the public locality bounding box to all feasible nearest ERA5 0.25-degree cells.

inct41_coordinate_uncertainty_replicatio.analysis: Exactly the same weak-label CallingIndex decomposition, dryness definition, covariates, date clustering, and threshold-dominance rule as the prefixed INCT20955 test.
inct41_coordinate_uncertainty_replicatio.robust_replication_rule: A Cerrado site conclusion is called coordinate-robust only if both candidate ERA5 cells give the same threshold-dominance classification and the same signs for total_ci, active_richness and excess_intensity dryness slopes.
inct41_coordinate_uncertainty_replicatio.interpretation: Independent site/biome test of recruitment-versus-intensification; still not a spatial-boundary matrix replication.
